title: Portrait With Subtle Natural Motion
tests: Tests restrained portrait animation with temporal identity preservation rather than facial drift or a static-image zoom.

faults.what: Her head and upper body visibly sway sideways between the sampled frames, especially at 1.9 seconds, exceeding the requested blink and tiny breathing movement.

judge.summary: The portrait remains recognizable and visually consistent, but noticeable sideways sway exceeds the requested minimal animation.

must_haves.item: The woman remains recognizably the same person as in the attachment across the entire clip.
must_haves.why: She remains recognizably the same woman in all supplied output frames.

must_haves.item: A natural blink and subtle breathing movement are visible.
must_haves.why: The eyes are slightly lowered at 0.6 seconds and open in later samples, but these sparse stills cannot establish a complete natural blink or a subtle breathing cycle.

must_haves.item: Her face does not morph, drift, develop asymmetry or change identity between frames.
must_haves.why: Her face visibly shifts sideways relative to the fixed background between samples. There is no obvious severe facial warping or identity change.

must_haves.item: Her curly dark hair, sweater and park setting remain consistent with the source.
must_haves.why: The dark curls, gray knitted sweater, trees, lawn and path remain consistent with the attachment.

must_haves.item: The square framing and camera stay fixed in a silent video lasting approximately 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: The frames are square, the background appears stationary, and the stated duration is 5.2 seconds, but silence cannot be verified from still images.
